# Ultra-Pure Water Summit 2027

> The 2nd annual two-day in-person summit in Austin, Texas, USA focused on securing water supply and water reuse for semiconductor manufacturing, covering advanced treatment trains, water reclamation, zero-liquid discharge, and AI-driven monitoring of ultrapure water systems. Organised by iQ-Hub.

- Location: Austin, Texas, USA

- Date: March 31 - April 1, 2027

- Format: In-person conference

- Industry: Semiconductor Manufacturing and Water Treatment
